title: Engineering knowledge
summary: Represent useful requirement, code, test, and build relationships without inventing them.

sections.label: Possible relationships
sections.text: Requirement → affected component or interface → relevant check → recorded result. Use source locations and decision records that actually exist.

sections.label: Graph application example
sections.text: An ontology concept can connect a requirement to a query, service or UI. Confluence decisions and Bitbucket locations can provide source links in that particular toolchain.

sections.label: Implementation choice
sections.text: Begin with a traceability table or existing metadata. Add a development knowledge graph only if actual queries and maintenance needs justify it.

sections.label: Acceptance
sections.text: Relationships have provenance and versions. Model-extracted suggestions remain distinguishable from confirmed dependencies.

sections.label: Gap review: workflow use and checks
items: Recommended workflow use: Requirements and evidence, Architecture and impact, Tests and review. Use when connecting a requirement to affected implementation and then to observed verification evidence, using links the project actually maintains. This is an Atlas recommendation reviewed on 2026-10-15, not a mandatory process or an observed execution result.
Check output to obtain: Produce a small traceability table linking one required behavior, affected component and meaningful check.
Check output to obtain: Follow the links in both directions at recorded revisions and identify broken or stale locations.
Check output to obtain: Label model-suggested dependencies as proposed until an implementation or reviewer check confirms them.

catalog.applicability: Use this when you want to represent links between requirements, components, checks and recorded results. Start from a traceability table or existing metadata and add a development knowledge graph only when actual queries and maintenance needs justify it.
catalog.limits: Reading a topic does not configure tools, execute a workflow or establish passing evidence.
